method: same precomputed order, randomized two baseline and two reduced runs per block; bootstrap median of paired ratios

provenance.ratio_definition: sqrt(b[0] * b[1] / (a[0] * a[1])): geometric mean of the two pointed times divided by geometric mean of the two baseline times
provenance.aa_ratio_definition: a[1] / a[0], with labels independent of randomized chronological order

bootstrap.rng_stream: same seeded stream as job shuffling; ratio and A/A bootstrap calls follow each case

provenance.timed_source_description: Development reduced_scan.py prototype imported once at process start, before the packaged seconds API, helper extraction, terminal odd-rank check, added output fields, and separate decision API. The source was not snapshotted or hashed before this historical run.
provenance.algorithm_identity_audit: The pointed evaluation, ReducedPlanar methods, last-crossing cut selection on nonempty diagrams, ReducedScan, and underlying upstream Planar/FastScan/ordering/scan implementations match the final package. The final rank wrapper adds preparation/terminal helpers, an extra PD normalization, an odd-rank validation, seconds-to-deadline conversion, and output fields. The packaged wrapper is not claimed to be the exact timed source.
provenance.status: historical prototype timings; prefer reduced_benchmark_final.json for the measured final packaged API
